title: Scenario Generation for RCMEM
text: First look basic location info three tidal stations interest. use San Diego, Los Angeles, San Francisco. Create tidal scenarios year 2100 SSPs 126, 245, 370. Note generateFullTidalScenario() makes internal calls VulnToolkit::noaa() sometimes fail NOAA’s server overloaded. vignette use cached result avoid failures. see failures interactive use, wait seconds try .
code: gauge_tab <- PEcAn.data.water::noaa_us_gauge_info |>   filter(noaa_id %in% c(c(9410170, 9410660, 9414290))) |>   rename(gauge_id = noaa_id) scenario_output <- PEcAn.data.water::generateFullTidalScenario(    station_id = c(9410170, 9410660, 9414290),    run_hindcast = T,    run_forecast = T,    hindcast_start = lubridate::ymd(gauge_tab$startDate),    forecast_start = 2024,    forecast_end = 2100,    scenario = c("ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370"),    target_quantile = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75),    include_lt_tidal_const = T,    datum_start_year = 1980,    datum_end_year = 2025)
